company.shortDescription: Cashmere is provides crypto wallet for web3 startups that helps to securely manage the funds.
company.description: Cashmere creates a safer crypto wallet that secures treasury. It transfers funds using the multi-signature signing feature, which combines the flexibility of hot wallets with the storage security of cold wallets. Cashmere focuses on assisting people in securely storing their cryptocurrency. It will safeguard cryptocurrencies even if hot wallets such as Slope and Phantom are compromised.

productsAndServices.description: A multisignature wallet on Solana designed for secure management of digital assets with team approvals and treasury controls.
